question: Which AL object type holds test functions in Business Central?
options: A codeunit with the Subtype property set to Test
A page with the PageType property set to Test
A report with the ProcessingOnly property set to true
A query with the QueryType property set to Test
explanation: Test functions live in test codeunits, which are codeunits with Subtype = Test.
source: Introduction to test automation in Business Central (Microsoft Learn)

question: Which attribute marks a procedure in a test codeunit as a test?
explanation: The [Test] attribute tells the test runner that the procedure is a test to execute.
source: Introduction to test automation in Business Central (Microsoft Learn)

question: Which web service type is described by a WSDL document?
explanation: SOAP services describe themselves with a WSDL. OData describes itself with a $metadata document instead.
source: Work with web services in Dynamics 365 Business Central (Microsoft Learn)

question: What is the main purpose of a connect app?
options: To connect Business Central to an external service or product
To replace code in the base application
To provide test data for other apps
To change how the platform itself runs
explanation: Connect apps integrate Business Central with an external service or product. Add-on apps extend Business Central with new functionality.
source: Introduction to application types in Business Central (Microsoft Learn)

question: Which standard codeunit lets you hold binary data in memory without a table record?
explanation: The Temp Blob codeunit holds data in memory and gives you streams to read and write it.
source: Introduction to the basics of file management in Dynamics 365 Business Central (Microsoft Learn)

question: In a page extension, which keyword adds a new field after an existing control?
explanation: Inside the layout section of a page extension, addafter places new controls after an existing one. addfirst, addlast and addbefore work the same way.
source: Extend and modify an existing page in Dynamics 365 Business Central (Microsoft Learn)
